QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_47

question.text: The 'Performance Risk' category in a Cat III PPM typically includes:

answer.text: Only credit risk of underlying investees
Risks from investment strategy, dependence on manager, liquidity of fund investments, concentration and distribution of income

explanation.text: The Logic: Performance Risk in a Cat III PPM is a broad taxonomy covering investment-strategy risk, dependence on the manager, liquidity and realisation risk, concentration risk, distribution/repatriation of income, co-investments, geo-political risks, and potential loss of investment. The Trap: Options A, C, and D each capture only a single fragment (credit risk, GST, or currency risk) and miss the breadth of the Performance Risk taxonomy. Note: The full list of Performance Risk factors is set out in the workbook's risk-factors section for Category III AIFs.
